intro.line: Hey Priyanshi, I made you something.
intro.hint: Tap the heart to open it and use your earphones

home.headline: I'm sorry. Sit with me for a while?
home.subtext: I made you this little place. There's a letter, our memories, and our songs. Take your time.

letter.skipHint: Tap the letter to show it all
paragraphs: I've started this letter more times than I can count at this point, because I wanted to get it right. You deserve more than a quick sorry over text, baby, so here it is, written properly.
I don't know whether this would be enough to win you over again, but I don't wanna lose someone I love so immensely and I want to do anything just to have you back.

Let's start from the beginning, when I had came to Shillong it was supposed to be just a 2 year posting, and I had made my mind that I won't make any friends here. After my mother's death I was too afraid to get attached to anyone else

I used to just read, instead of making friends, always soaked in books. After my mom's death I never wanted to get attached again, I was too afraid to lose people I love. But slowley we started talking and god we never stopped talking

Every new posting came with a set of friends for me but I never had a best friend like you, you were so different. You were not only the first girl I talked to but the way we both understand each other, nobody ever did.
We talked so much, bus me chadhne se lekar utarne tak, recess ke time and sometimes we would even try to bunk the class just so that we can get to see each other (although I was pretty bad at it).

You know I never liked flowers, but the day when you gifted me a flower at the bus stop, I just could never go back. I don't have those flowers now but anytime I see a wild flower, no matter what I am doing, I would just take a break and appreciate it for a while and replay those memories we have weaved over the years, thank you baby for that
You made me feel alive and I hope I made you feel alive too. Even if the world had to come to an end tomorrow, I will still be the happiest person in the world if I can see you smile again.

I know things have gotten so bad, but you know what jaan I still have some hope. I really wished that atleast I could have you as friend but I can see this isn't working out. Even my therapist, when I told her about us, says, its hard for lovers to go back to friends

I know I have made promises that I couldn't keep, but no more, from this day on jaan, I would never make a promise that I cannot keep. I have been too much of an asshole and I want change all of it yaar. Babe, suno na, I have loved you unconditionally and I would stand up to my responsibilities for you, cause no matter how hard I try I just can't stop loving you

Babe you know, every single day has been so hard for me and I know its been the same with you. I know we have been suffering so much together, I can't see us like this yaar, I just don't want all those things I have told to just go down in vain
Sweetheart, I am on my shaking and tears are falling of my eyes as I write this, just give me one last chance. Leave me if I break any more promises or if I act like an asshole

But don't let our love fade away this easily. Baby just give our love one last chance, I would never ask for anything in my life. I will be the best person that I can possibly be, I will be the man that you deserve.
However, whatever you decide, don't forget I will always be there for you. My have given you my heart and there is a part of me that will always be yours.
By the way thank you so much for reading this. I hope I could have atleast made you smile atleast once
letter.postscript: P.S. There's a question for you just below. Answer honestly. (But also, please say yes.)

forgive.question: So... do you forgive me?
forgive.yesMessage: Thank you for giving me another chance. I love you, more than I'm good at saying.

items.caption: Meet this Moron
items.message: This evil bastard, when he was small but still dumb

items.caption: And then the earth was blessed
items.message: You were born, I wish I were there to welcome you to this world with a warm hug

items.caption: And our fate started to intertwine
items.message: I just joined APS Shillong but covid kept us locked

items.caption: We started talking
items.message: After 10th I started opening up to you and we used to talk all our way to school and back

items.caption: You made me fall in love with this world
items.message: After my mom's death, I started my search for true happiness and then after meeting you forgot to search for it, just to realise I was so happy... with you

items.caption: We went on walk to Malse together
items.message: After my mom's death, I started searching for true happiness and then after meeting you forgot to search for it, just to realise I was so happy... with you

items.caption: We used to get flowers for each other
items.message: That awesome year did came to an end, but not before we would celebrate the spring with plucking flowers for each other.

items.caption: You had to go to Delhi for your operation
items.message: I never told you how much I have cried for you. That was the last time I ever asked god for anything

items.caption: We started coming closer and closer...
items.message: We would spend every free second together and obviously people started shipping us, maybe they saw our spark

items.caption: And I was on Snapchat, only for you, always for you
items.message: We would start sharing our silly pics together, we were so young back then, so full of happiness

items.caption: I started visiting your house
items.message: My dad doesn't like me going to someone's house but I couldn't care less, I just need excuses to see you

items.caption: I started falling in love, and I fell so hard
items.message: The way you had loved me, nobody had ever loved me like that, my every heartbeat started becoming yours

items.caption: We became teachers in partner
items.message: I had so many insecurities, couldn't even civil dress but you healed me

items.caption: And during Pooja Holidays, we got together
items.message: All the manifesting came to reality, and we become just for each other officially, I still can't shake that feeling

items.caption: And then we had our first kiss
items.message: Remember that day, my heart was beating so fast it would have come out, and you fainted too lol 😂

items.caption: We started getting so reckless
items.message: I almost shat my pants that day lol 😂, but I would never regret it

items.caption: We would kiss before our pre boards
items.message: Remember we would just find excuses to kiss behind the pillar of David Hall, gosh I miss those days

items.caption: You looked so good dancing that day
items.message: Time seemed to have stopped that day when I saw you dance, It was the most beautiful sight in the world

items.caption: The last day of our exam
items.message: And that was the last day of our school, I am so glad I got to spend with such a beautiful person and also such a beautiful heart ❤️

items.caption: And just like that we were in a LDR
items.message: I had just a small dumb phone, yet you never complained, we would chat on SMS even though it sucked, but atleast I had you

items.caption: I would make excuse get the laptop
items.message: After not seeing each for so long, we could finally see each other. Thanks for your key chain, I looked at our picture everday.

items.caption: Every calf or goat still reminds me of you
items.message: You know every since I came to know you love cows and goats, every time I see one it makes me smile so hard thinking of you

items.caption: I joined college and video calls became our routine
items.message: I would do so many stupid stuff on video call LOL

items.caption: We missed each other so much
items.message: I would see couple all around me and every time I see one I would see us in them

items.caption: You joined college too
items.message: We got into college, despite all the attention we got from others we never leave each other

items.caption: I was so depressed in my 2nd Semester
items.message: But I had you with me. Thanks for being the only person that understood me.

items.caption: We would choose clothes and pictures for your birthday
items.message: Being with you has always been the best thing of my life.

items.caption: And we finally met after more that 2 years
items.message: You came to Shillong and we finally met. We were so happy to finally be together, our love had our first win

items.caption: I still wanna hold your hand
items.message: Holding your hand feels like heaven and will always feel like so.

items.caption: And we met again...
items.message: Its so crazy to meet after just 4 months. Every second I spent with you has been the most precious second of my life
